commit.title: decode: mark the queued picture as failed if frame submission fails
commit.message:
decode: mark the queued picture as failed if frame submission fails

If dav2d_submit_frame() fails after the picture was added to the output
queue, the picture is never decoded, so its progress was never updated,
and with frame threading, output_image() waited for it forever (busy-
looping when draining). Set its progress to FRAME_ERROR, so it's output
as an error instead.
